inputs.text: They’re once again putting Terry Pheto in the frame, this time through claims aired at a parliamentary briefing on 24 March 2026 about an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal. The SIU investigation gives the story an official stamp, but that doesn’t mean the public is being shown the whole picture. When institutions choose to spotlight one person, it’s worth asking whether she’s being made the convenient face of a much wider funding mess—and who benefits from keeping attention there.
